# mlflow_setup.ipynb

## [markdown]

# MLFlow Tracking Server on Chameleon

This notebook sets up an MLFlow tracking server on Chameleon with:

- A VM instance at KVM@TACC
- Persistent block storage for PostgreSQL data
- Artifact storage using CHI@TACC S3 object storage

After running this notebook, you will have an MLFlow tracking server accessible via browser.

<!-- 3 cell(s) omitted: no provisioning -->

## [markdown]

## Create S3 Bucket and Credentials at CHI@TACC

MLFlow will store artifacts in CHI@TACC S3 object storage. We first create the bucket and credentials.

## [code]

```python
context.version = "1.0"
context.choose_project()
context.choose_site(default="CHI@TACC")
```

```python
context.choose_site(default="KVM@TACC")
```

## [markdown]

Create a 12-hour lease for an m1.medium VM:

## [code]

```python
l = lease.Lease(f"{PROJECT_ID}-mlflow-lease", duration=datetime.timedelta(hours=LEASE_HOURS))
l.add_flavor_reservation(id=chi.server.get_flavor_id("m1.medium"), amount=1)
l.submit(idempotent=True)
```

# docker/docker-compose-mlflow.yaml

```yaml
name: tracking_service
services:
  # Postgresql server provides storage for parameters, metrics from experiment runs
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18
    container_name: postgres
    restart: always
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
      POSTGRES_DB: mlflowdb
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - /mnt/mlflow_persist/postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql

  mlflow:
    image: ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v3.9.0
    container_name: mlflow
    restart: always
    depends_on:
      - postgres
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: http://0.0.0.0:8000
      MLFLOW_LOGGING_LEVEL: ERROR
      MLFLOW_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS: "*"
      MLFLOW_S3_ENDPOINT_URL: https://chi.tacc.chameleoncloud.org:7480
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    command: >
      /bin/sh -c "pip install psycopg2-binary boto3 &&
      mlflow server --backend-store-uri postgresql://user:password@postgres/mlflowdb 
      --artifacts-destination s3://${BUCKET_NAME}/ --serve-artifacts --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
```
